items.title: OpenAPI代码生成器代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 可控 OpenAPI 文档者可借未转义字段注入 JS 到生成代码，执行后导致 RCE。
items.action_zh: 升级至0.31.0后修复版；临时仅用可信OpenAPI文档生成代码。
items.repro_note: 入口：代码生成读取 OpenAPI 文档；前置：文档可控；关键：未转义字段插值。
items.impact_scope: 开发/构建工具链，非直接公网暴露
items.description: openapi-typescript-codegen through 0.31.0 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling an OpenAPI document to inject JavaScript by supplying unescaped values interpolated into single-quoted string literals. Attackers can embed a single quote in path keys, parameter names, servers[0].url, or info.version to execute arbitrary JavaScript when generated clients are imported or service methods called.
